saw_lines: Gardeners buy seed and bulbs around the planting calendar, then reorder the same varieties every autumn when the window reopens.
So the sale is won on timing: a gardener who sees the planting window and a reason to order now buys.
Your 41 Google creatives, 29 of them text, should open on the planting window and 50 years of seed growing already on your homepage.
ads_1: Google ads opening on the planting window, with 50 years of seed as proof
